name: drupal/mcp_sentinel
description: Enterprise governance for AI-agent access to Drupal — policy profiles, field redaction, DLP, tamper-evident audit logging, and reliable webhooks over MCP / JSON:API / GraphQL.

suggest.drupal/mcp_server: Exposes MCP Sentinel Tool plugins to MCP clients (via the mcp_sentinel_server submodule). Strongly recommended.
suggest.drupal/graphql_compose: Enables the mcp_sentinel_graphql submodule: mutation gating, field redaction, and audit for the GraphQL endpoint.
suggest.drupal/mcp_tools: Adds 222 site-building tools (across 34 optional submodules, per the drupal/mcp_tools project) via the Tool API; MCP Sentinel governs them.
suggest.drupal/charts: Optional: upgrades the governance-dashboard inline-SVG charts to interactive, exportable charts (install a library submodule such as charts_chartjs). The dashboard works without it.
